Sub-System or Design Condition: All Seismic Design Categories (Wall Panel Flexure)
Design Formula / Governing Limit: F_p = max(0.4 * S_DS * I_e * W_p, 0.10 * W_p)

Sub-System or Design Condition: Connection to Flexible Diaphragm (z = h, Adjustment = 1.0)
Design Formula / Governing Limit: F_p = max(0.4 * S_DS * k_a * I_e * W_p, 0.2 * k_a * I_e * W_p, 5 psf); k_a = min(1.0 + L_f / 100, 2.0)

Sub-System or Design Condition: Connection NOT at Flexible Diaphragm (Rigid Diaphragm, k_a = 1.0)
Steel / Concrete / Masonry / Wood Wall Anchorage in SDC C-F
Design Formula / Governing Limit: Continuous ties between diaphragm chords designed for largest wall anchorage force F_p; sub-diaphragm L/W <= 2.5:1

Sub-System or Design Condition: Horizontal Seismic Force F_p (ATC-120 Updated Formulation)
Design Formula / Governing Limit: F_p = 0.4 * S_DS * I_p * W_p * (H_f / R_mu) * (C_AR / R_po); 0.3 * S_DS * I_p * W_p <= F_p <= 1.6 * S_DS * I_p * W_p
H_f = 1 + 2.5 * (z / h) (replaces legacy 1 + 2*z/h when T_a is unknown)

Sub-System or Design Condition: Building SFRS Parameters R, Omega_0, I_e Known
Design Formula / Governing Limit: R_mu = max(1.3, sqrt(1.1 * R / (I_e * Omega_0))); if at/below grade (z <= 0) or non-SFRS, R_mu = 1.0

Sub-System or Design Condition: Air-side HVAC, fans, air handlers, chillers, cooling towers, condensers (Rigidly mounted)
Design Formula / Governing Limit: Rigidly attached to structure without vibration isolators

Sub-System or Design Condition: Air-side HVAC, fans, air handlers, chillers, cooling towers (Vibration-isolated)
Design Formula / Governing Limit: Spring or elastomeric vibration isolators with seismic snubbers; b_v gap > 0.25 in. doubles F_p

Sub-System or Design Condition: Generators, batteries, inverters, motors, transformers, turbines (Rigid Base)
Design Formula / Governing Limit: Example: 2,000 lb Generator on concrete slab/floor (C_AR = 1.0, R_po = 1.5, Omega_0p = 2.0)

Sub-System or Design Condition: Boilers, furnaces, pressure vessels, water heaters, expansion tanks
Design Formula / Governing Limit: Requires upper and lower seismic strapping or base frame anchorage

Sub-System or Design Condition: Electrical panelboards, switchboards, motor control centers, switchgear, cabinets
Design Formula / Governing Limit: Floor-mounted or wall-mounted enclosures; evaluate h_cg overturning moment

Sub-System or Design Condition: Rooftop Solar Photovoltaic (PV) Arrays and Ballasted/Anchored Support Frames
Design Formula / Governing Limit: Combine with ASCE 7-22 Sec. 29.4.3 / 29.4.4 Rooftop Solar Wind Uplift/Downforce

Sub-System or Design Condition: Piping and tubing systems (High-deformability materials, welded/brazed joints)
Design Formula / Governing Limit: Fire sprinkler and mechanical piping systems (Ip = 1.5 for life-safety fire protection)

Sub-System or Design Condition: HVAC Ductwork and Electrical Conduit / Cable Trays
Design Formula / Governing Limit: Trapeze hangers and diagonal cable/strut seismic bracing

Category / Component Type: Overstrength factor Omega_0p applies to anchorage of nonstructural components to concrete and masonry per ASCE 7-22 Section 13.4.2 and ACI 318-19 Sections 17.10.5.3(d) / 17.10.6.3(c).
Vertical seismic force Ev = +/- 0.2 * S_DS * W_p (LRFD) or +/- 0.14 * S_DS * W_p (ASD) shall be applied concurrently with horizontal seismic force F_p at the equipment center of gravity (h_cg).

Orthogonal Load Combination (ASCE 7-22 Sec. 13.3.1): Apply 100% of F_p in one horizontal direction concurrently with 30% of F_p in the perpendicular horizontal direction to evaluate corner anchor tensions.

Wood Ledger Forbidden Practice (ASCE 7-22 Sec. 12.11.2.2.5 / IBC Sec. 1604.8.3): Anchorage of concrete or masonry walls shall NOT be accomplished by use of toe-nails or nails subject to withdrawal, nor shall wood ledgers or framing be used in cross-grain bending or cross-grain tension.
